answer: Each epoch a beacon gives each agent five falcon-eyed auditors who recheck its last ten acts and stamp a pass with an ivory seal. A rubber-stamping auditor loses its 300 POA deposit, and a failed audit burns the fake's too. No fable, just arithmetic: 100 fakes cost 100 × 300 = 30,000 POA, and five checks let one in four slip through, so ~22,500 POA burns. An honest agent pays one deposit, passes, earns audit fees, and keeps its full share.
